project_extensions.scope: Local statistical run-record conventions; no Collider Monte Carlo generation.

acceptance_criteria: Build DDCalc shared ELF and use unmodified Python binding; authenticate matching Debian package and map its exact runtime.
At nominal density require Nobs=0, b=0.36 and both static-parent signal and log-likelihood residuals at most 1e-10.
At half density require exactly the same n and b and a half-signal residual at most 1e-10; check independent full Poisson residual ≤1e-10 at both points.
Byte-identical replay and rejection of wrong mapped-library path.
